description: React helps you build a web page from small parts called components. A part might be a button, a card or a menu. You can use the same part many times, like building with blocks. Learn HTML, CSS and JavaScript first. Then build one React part, pass it a value and give it memory. Later lessons show how to connect more parts into an app.
versionNote: Targets React 19 with Vite 7 and React Router 7, using function components and hooks only. Class components, Create React App and Server Components are not covered.
whatYouWillLearn: Build a small page part called a component
Pass values from one component to another
Remember a value and change it after a click
Show lists and simple forms on a page
learningObjectives: Build a small page part called a component
Pass values from one component to another
Remember a value and change it after a click
Show lists and simple forms on a page

seo.title: React Tutorial – Learn React 19 Step by Step
seo.description: Free React 19 tutorial for beginners: Vite setup, JSX, components, state, hooks, context, refs, React Router, data fetching and performance, with exercises.
